GTA 6 Services & Unlocks

Registration, the WAiNK app, Slim Jim, Key Cloner and every other unlock that changes what you can do.

15 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Moses / Watkins Auto Parts — Vehicle RegistrationA Port Gellhorn mechanic can make a stolen car legally yours — the first one is on the house. Pay 'n' Spray — Registration of Tracked CarsFrom Chapter 3, the spray shops handle the paperwork Moses can't. WAiNK Scanning AppPoint your phone at any car and it tells you its secrets before you commit to stealing it. Slim Jim (Chapter 2 Unlock)A thin strip of metal that opens locked cars quietly — no smashed glass, no alarm. Key Cloner (Chapter 3 Unlock)High-end cars don't have keys to steal — this phone trick copies the key instead. Scooter Bros Delivery AppYour registered cars are never far away — an app brings them to you, for a fee. Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3 Unlock)An angle grinder for the heavy padlocks on Leonida's yellow shipping containers. Snap Gun (Chapter 3 Unlock)A lockpick gun that opens building doors silently — the store alarm, however, stays awake. Vice City Real Estate AppThe only property shop in Leonida lives on your phone — and it sells garages, not houses. Pay 'n' Spray Network (19 Locations)Nineteen spray shops, one per neighbourhood that matters — here is the whole network and its house rules. Refuelling & Gas Stations (57)Yes, cars need fuel — no, it is not the chore the pre-launch rumours promised. Wanted Level & the Heat SystemSix stars, and the police remember what you look like — losing sight is not losing heat. Focus Mode & Character StatsBoth sticks at once buys you time — and shows you what the room is hiding. Mod Shops (14)Fourteen mod shops, each with a speciality — including the bikes Pay 'n' Spray turns away. Partner System & Character SwappingTwo protagonists, one crew: swapping, summoning and handing off loot are systems, not cutscenes.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
